sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 在2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她曾被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫简·多伊（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于查出了她的名字叫艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是Casefile Presents推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: It was around 7.45pm on Monday, November 16, 2009, when a 911 operator in Utah picked up a call from a woman named Pamela Mortensen.
sentences.zh: 那是2009年11月16日星期一晚上7点45分左右，犹他州的一名911接线员接到了一名名叫帕梅拉·莫滕森的女性打来的电话。

sentences.en: She explained that she and her husband had just survived a home invasion at a house belonging to Pamela's father-in-law, Kay Mortensen.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，她和丈夫刚刚在帕梅拉公公凯·莫滕森的房子里遭遇了一起非法闯入民宅案并幸存下来。

sentences.en: Pamela said the perpetrators had tied her and her husband up in the living room, while telling them Kay was restrained on the second floor.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉说，行凶者把她和丈夫绑在起居室里，并告诉他们凯被控制在二楼。

sentences.en: Pamela seemed unable to recall how many offenders were involved, hesitating as she said,
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉似乎记不清有多少罪犯参与了，她犹豫着说道：

sentences.en: Um, there could have been three.
sentences.zh: 嗯，可能有三个。

sentences.en: She explained they had been ordered not to look at the intruders, so she couldn't describe their features.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，他们被命令不要看着闯入者，所以她无法描述他们的外貌特征。

sentences.en: Pamela also claimed it had been too dark for her to see what kind of car they were driving.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉还声称当时天太黑，她看不清他们开的是什么车。

sentences.en: When asked if the intruders had been white, black or Hispanic, Pamela replied in a slightly terse tone,
sentences.zh: 当被问及闯入者是白人、黑人还是西班牙裔时，帕梅拉用略显生硬的语气回答：

sentences.en: Ma'am, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 女士，我不知道。

sentences.en: The operator found the call strange.
sentences.zh: 接线员觉得这个电话很奇怪。

sentences.en: For someone who had just lived through such a traumatic experience, Pamela's voice was calm and steady.
sentences.zh: 对于一个刚刚经历过如此创伤性经历的人来说，帕梅拉的声音平静而平稳。

sentences.en: Her answers were also vague and unhelpful.
sentences.zh: 她的回答也很模糊，毫无帮助。

sentences.en: Pamela said that she thought her father-in-law might be dead, but she wasn't sure.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉说她认为她的公公可能已经死了，但她不敢确定。

sentences.en: The operator asked to speak to Pamela's husband, Roger Mortensen, instead.
sentences.zh: 接线员要求转而与帕梅拉的丈夫罗杰·莫滕森交谈。

sentences.en: When Roger took the phone, he said there had been two intruders, and both were white.
sentences.zh: 当罗杰接起电话时，他说有两名闯入者，而且两人都是白人。

sentences.en: They had stolen his driver's license from his wallet and threatened to harm Roger and his family if he called the police.
sentences.zh: 他们从他的钱包里偷走了他的驾照，并威胁说如果他报警就伤害罗杰和他的家人。

sentences.en: Roger explained that after the intruders left and he'd escaped his restraints, he went upstairs to find his father.
sentences.zh: 罗杰解释说，在闯入者离开且他挣脱束缚后，他上楼去寻找他的父亲。

sentences.en: However, Kay Mortensen was on the bathroom floor, cold to the touch.
sentences.zh: 然而，凯·莫滕森躺在浴室的地板上，身体冰凉。

sentences.en: Roger remarked matter-of-factly,
sentences.zh: 罗杰客观地评述道：

sentences.en: He's leaned over facing forward in the bathtub with his throat sliced with a butcher knife all the way up.
sentences.zh: 他面朝前趴在浴缸里，喉咙被屠夫刀从头到尾割开。

sentences.en: The operator asked if Roger knew why anyone would want to harm Kay.
sentences.zh: 接线员询问罗杰是否知道为什么会有人想要伤害凯。

sentences.en: Roger answered,
sentences.zh: 罗杰回答说：

sentences.en: Yeah, he's rich.
sentences.zh: 是的，他很有钱。

sentences.en: Deputies from the county sheriff's department were dispatched to Kay Mortensen's address near Payson, Utah.
sentences.zh: 县治安官办公室的副警长们被派往位于犹他州佩森附近的凯·莫滕森的住所。

sentences.en: The large house sat on a hill at the end of a winding driveway and was one of two houses owned by 70-year-old Kay.
sentences.zh: 这栋大房子坐落在一条蜿蜒车道尽头的小山丘上，是70岁的凯拥有的两栋房子之一。

sentences.en: He and his wife, Darla, spent most of their time at their primary residence in St George, about 250 miles south near the Arizona border.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子达拉大部分时间都在他们位于圣乔治的主要住所度过，该住所位于南边约250英里处，靠近亚利桑那州边境。

sentences.en: But they usually checked in on the Payson property about twice a month.
sentences.zh: 但他们通常每个月大约会去佩森的房产查看两次。

sentences.en: Lately, they hadn't been there much at all.
sentences.zh: 最近，他们几乎没怎么去过那里。

sentences.en: Both Kay and Darla were devoted members of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.
sentences.zh: 凯和达拉都是耶稣基督后期圣徒教会的虔诚成员。

sentences.en: Three weeks earlier, they'd completed an 18-month mission together at Fort Cove, Utah.
sentences.zh: 三周前，他们刚刚在犹他州科夫堡共同完成了为期18个月的传教活动。

sentences.en: The older couple had only been married for about three years and had bonded over their dedication to their church.
sentences.zh: 这对年长的夫妇结婚才大约三年，他们因对教会的奉献而结缘。

sentences.en: Kay's 48-year-old son Roger, the eldest of his three adult children, lived near the Payson residence and had been checking on it often while they were away.
sentences.zh: 凯48岁的儿子罗杰是他三个成年子女中的老大，住在佩森住所附近，在他们不在的时候经常去查看情况。

sentences.en: Shortly after Kay and Darla finished their mission, Kay went to stay at the house,
sentences.zh: 就在凯和达拉完成传教后不久，凯去这栋房子居住，

sentences.en: while Darla went to look after her granddaughters in Salt Lake City, which was about an hour away.
sentences.zh: 而达拉则去盐湖城照顾她的孙女们，盐湖城距离这里大约有一小时车程。

sentences.en: Darla was due to rejoin her husband later that night, and then she and Kay had been planning to return to their St George residence the next day.
sentences.zh: 达拉原计划当晚晚些时候与丈夫会合，然后她和凯计划第二天返回他们在圣乔治的住所。

sentences.en: Kay's son Roger and his 34-year-old wife Pamela told investigators that was why they'd decided to go over that evening.
sentences.zh: 凯的儿子罗杰和他34岁的妻子帕梅拉告诉调查人员，这就是他们决定当晚过去的原因。

sentences.en: They thought it might be nice to spend some time with Kay and Darla before they left.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得在离开前花点时间陪陪凯和达拉可能会很不错。

sentences.en: Pamela had phoned Darla's cell phone and asked if they'd like to play board games later that evening.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉给达拉的手机打了电话，问他们是否想在当晚晚些时候玩桌游。

sentences.en: Darla agreed.
sentences.zh: 达拉同意了。

sentences.en: Pamela had received a pecan pie at work earlier that day, and knowing it was Kay's favourite, she and Roger decided to bring it with them.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉那天早些时候在工作时收到了一块山核桃派，深知这是凯的最爱，她和罗杰决定把它带上。

sentences.en: Roger and Pamela provided a more detailed version of the story they'd shared with 911.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和帕梅拉提供了他们曾向911讲述过的事情的更详细版本。

sentences.en: Prior to going to Kay's house, they had tried calling his landline and his cell phone.
sentences.zh: 在去凯的房子之前，他们曾试图拨打他的座机和手机。

sentences.en: Both calls went unanswered.
sentences.zh: 两个电话都无人接听。

sentences.en: This wasn't unusual, as sometimes Kay would doze off and not hear his phones.
sentences.zh: 这并不罕见，因为有时凯会打瞌睡而听不到电话响。

sentences.en: Roger and Pamela drove over with the pecan pie just as dusk was falling.
sentences.zh: 暮色降临之际，罗杰和帕梅拉开着车载着山核桃派驶了过去。

sentences.en: When they arrived at Kay's house, they noticed an unfamiliar car parked in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达凯的房子时，他们注意到车道上停着一辆不认识的车。

sentences.en: Roger identified it as a compact, hatchback-style vehicle that was dark in colour, possibly blue.
sentences.zh: 罗杰辨认出这是一辆紧凑型掀背式汽车，颜色很深，可能是蓝色的。

sentences.en: Lights were on inside the house.
sentences.zh: 屋里的灯亮着。

sentences.en: Figuring that perhaps Kay had company over and that's why he hadn't answered the phone,
sentences.zh: 心想或许凯有客人在家，所以才没接电话，

sentences.en: Roger and Pamela knocked on the door.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和帕梅拉敲了敲门。

sentences.en: It was answered by an unfamiliar, young, white male who the couple said they thought was a handyman.
sentences.zh: 开门的是一个陌生的年轻白人男子，这对夫妇说他们以为那是个杂工。

sentences.en: Kay had been having issues with his internet connection lately and was also planning on replacing some carpet.
sentences.zh: 凯最近的互联网连接一直有问题，也正计划更换一些地毯。

sentences.en: Pamela assumed the man was there to help with one of those tasks.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉以为这个人是来帮忙处理其中一项任务的。

sentences.en: Pamela asked if Kay was home and the man said yes, he was upstairs.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉问凯在家吗，那名男子说在的，他在楼上。

sentences.en: Pamela explained that they were there to drop off a pie and the man replied, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉解释说他们是来送派的，那男子回答说，进去吧。

sentences.en: Pamela and Roger entered the home and Pamela made her way up a set of interior steps that led inside.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉和罗杰进入了屋里，帕梅拉顺着通往内部的一组室内阶梯往上走。

sentences.en: Then she heard the man ask her to come back down as the front door clicked shut behind her.
sentences.zh: 接着，她听到那名男子让她下来，而她身后的前门咔哒一声关上了。

sentences.en: At the same time, a second man appeared on the staircase that led to the first floor and began walking towards them.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，第二名男子出现在通往一楼的楼梯上，并开始朝他们走来。

sentences.en: In his hands were a number of zip ties and a black, semi-automatic handgun.
sentences.zh: 他手里拿着好几根扎带和一把黑色的半自动手枪。

sentences.en: You're in the wrong place at the wrong time, he told the couple.
sentences.zh: 你们在错误的时间来到了错误的地方，他对这对夫妇说。

sentences.en: He ordered them to bind each other's wrists with the zip ties before marching them into Kay's living room.
sentences.zh: 他命令他们用扎带互相绑住对方的手腕，然后把他们押进凯的起居室。

sentences.en: According to Roger and Pamela, they were clean-cut white men aged in their early to mid-twenties and dressed in Levi jeans and t-shirts.
sentences.zh: 据罗杰和帕梅拉描述，他们是干净利落的白人男子，年龄在二十出头到二十五岁左右，穿着李维斯牛仔裤和T恤。

sentences.en: Both had short hair that appeared to have been dyed black and moustaches or goatees.
sentences.zh: 两人都留着看起来像是染成黑色的短发，并留着小胡子或山羊胡。

sentences.en: The couple said they looked the same.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇说他们长得一模一样。

sentences.en: Roger believed they were the same height and size as him, making them around 5 foot 9 and between 150 to 165 pounds.
sentences.zh: 罗杰认为他们和他的身高体型相同，大约5英尺9英寸高，体重在150到165磅之间。

sentences.en: Roger tried to bargain with the men, begging,
sentences.zh: 罗杰试图跟这些人讲条件，哀求道：

sentences.en: just let us leave, let us take our pecan pie and leave.
sentences.zh: 就让我们走吧，让我们带上山核桃派离开。

sentences.en: But the men refused, making the couple kneel on the living room floor in front of the television instead.
sentences.zh: 但这些人拒绝了，而是让这对夫妇跪在电视机前的起居室地板上。

sentences.en: Then they bound their ankles with the zip ties as well.
sentences.zh: 然后他们也用扎带绑住了他们的脚踝。

sentences.en: When Pamela asked where Kay was, they told her he was restrained upstairs.
sentences.zh: 当帕梅拉问凯在哪里时，他们告诉她凯在楼上被绑着。

sentences.en: The couple said the intruders were almost polite.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇说，这些闯入者甚至显得很有礼貌。

sentences.en: Roger had a back injury and they checked that he was comfortable as they restrained him.
sentences.zh: 罗杰有背伤，他们在束缚他的时候还确认他是否觉得舒服。

sentences.en: But they were threatening as well.
sentences.zh: 但他们同时也发出了威胁。

sentences.en: They rummaged through the couple's pockets, confiscating their cell phones and IDs.
sentences.zh: 他们翻找这对夫妇的口袋，没收了他们的手机和身份证件。

sentences.en: At one point, one of the men said that because Roger and Pamela had seen their faces, they would have to kill them.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，其中一名男子说，因为罗杰和帕梅拉看到了他们的脸，他们必须杀了他们。

sentences.en: Pamela felt panicked until she noticed a picture of Jesus Christ that Kay had hanging on the wall.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉感到惊慌失措，直到她注意到凯挂在墙上的一幅耶稣基督画像。

sentences.en: Being a woman of faith, the picture gave her comfort.
sentences.zh: 作为一个有信仰的女性，这幅画给了她安慰。

sentences.en: She began praying silently to God, repeating the words,
sentences.zh: 她开始默默向上帝祈祷，重复着这样的话：

sentences.en: If you're there, save me.
sentences.zh: 如果你在那里，救救我。

sentences.en: Soon, the two men headed outside, leaving the couple alone in the living room.
sentences.zh: 不久，两名男子走到外面，留这对夫妇独自在起居室里。

sentences.en: There was a large window in the room that looked out over the east side of the property.
sentences.zh: 房间里有一扇大窗户，可以俯瞰房产的东侧。

sentences.en: Pamela gazed out the window and saw a figure standing outside in the dimming light, holding what looked like a broom.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉凝视着窗外，看到一个身影站在渐渐变暗的光线中的室外，手里拿着看起来像扫帚的东西。

sentences.en: The figure noticed Pam looking and gestured for her to look away.
sentences.zh: 那个身影注意到帕姆在看，便示意她把视线移开。

sentences.en: She did so and told Roger he should also keep his head down.
sentences.zh: 她照做了，并告诉罗杰他也应该把头低下来。

sentences.en: The couple said they were left alone in the room for between 30 and 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇说，他们被单独留在房间里大约30到45分钟。

sentences.en: At one point, Roger started to pray aloud.
sentences.zh: 有一会儿，罗杰开始大声祈祷。

sentences.en: Like his father, he was a member of the LDS church.
sentences.zh: 和他的父亲一样，他是LDS（后期圣徒）教会的成员。

sentences.en: Eventually, the two men returned.
sentences.zh: 最终，两名男子回来了。

sentences.en: Pamela nudged Roger, indicating he should be quiet due to the men's presence.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉推了推罗杰，示意由于这些男子的出现，他应该保持安静。

sentences.en: Roger stopped, but the men told him to continue.
sentences.zh: 罗杰停了下来，但那些男子叫他继续。

sentences.en: Then, they folded their arms across their chests and bowed their heads, which was the traditional praying stance in the LDS faith, while listening in silence.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们双臂在胸前交叉并低下头，这是LDS信仰中的传统祈祷姿势，同时静静地听着。

sentences.en: When Roger finished his prayer, one of the men pulled up a barstool and sat down in front of the couple.
sentences.zh: 当罗杰结束祈祷时，其中一名男子拉过一张吧台凳，在这对夫妇面前坐了下来。

sentences.en: He began peppering them with questions, asking if they knew of any visitors Kay might be expecting.
sentences.zh: 他开始连续向他们提问，问他们是否知道凯可能在等什么访客。

sentences.en: They told him Kay's wife, Dala, would be coming home soon.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉他，凯的妻子达拉很快就会回家。

sentences.en: The man looked unfazed and unsurprised to hear this.
sentences.zh: 那名男子听了这话显得很镇定，一点也不惊讶。

sentences.en: Then, he asked if Roger and Pamela had any children and whether anyone was waiting for them to return home.
sentences.zh: 接着，他问罗杰和帕梅拉是否有孩子，以及是否有人在等他们回家。

sentences.en: These questions made Roger and Pamela nervous.
sentences.zh: 这些问题让罗杰和帕梅拉感到紧张。

sentences.en: It sounded like their lives were hanging in the balance depending on how they answered.
sentences.zh: 听起来他们的生死存亡取决于他们如何回答。

sentences.en: But something had shifted in the man's demeanour after hearing Roger pray.
sentences.zh: 但在听到罗杰祈祷后，那名男子的态度发生了一些转变。

sentences.en: He said they had decided to let the couple go.
sentences.zh: 他说他们已经决定放这对夫妇走。

sentences.en: He told them they should tell the police that three black men were responsible for the crime and kept Roger's driver's licence so he had his home address.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，他们应该告诉警察是三个黑人男子犯下了这起罪行，并留下了罗杰的驾照，这样他就有了罗杰的家庭住址。

sentences.en: If Roger told the police the truth, the man warned, quote,
sentences.zh: 那名男子警告说，如果罗杰把实情告诉警察，原话是，

sentences.en: We will hurt your family.
sentences.zh: 我们会伤害你的家人。

sentences.en: Roger and Pamela told the sheriff's deputies about this script they had been told to follow and said that was why their 911 call had been odd.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和帕梅拉向警长副手们讲述了他们被告知要遵循的这个剧本，并表示这就是他们的911报警电话显得很奇怪的原因。

sentences.en: They weren't sure whether to tell the truth or their attacker's story.
sentences.zh: 他们不确定是该说出真相还是袭击者编造的故事。

sentences.en: After the two men fled the property in the blue hatchback,
sentences.zh: 在这两名男子驾驶蓝色掀背车逃离房产后，

sentences.en: Roger and Pamela had waited about 45 minutes before removing their bindings.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和帕梅拉等了大约45分钟才解开束缚。

sentences.en: They said they were scared that the man might come back.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们害怕那名男子可能会回来。

sentences.en: Pamela said she had first wriggled out of the zip tyres on her wrist, then reached into Roger's pocket for his keys because he kept a pocket knife on his keychain.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉说她先是扭动身子挣脱了手腕上的扎带，然后把手伸进罗杰的口袋去拿他的钥匙，因为他的钥匙链上挂着一把折叠刀。

sentences.en: She then used the knife to cut off Roger's tyres and the ones around their ankles.
sentences.zh: 然后她用这把刀割断了罗杰身上的扎带以及他们脚踝上的扎带。

sentences.en: Once they were freed, Pamela picked up a nearby phone to call 911 while Roger checked on his father.
sentences.zh: 一旦获得自由，帕梅拉就拿起附近的一部电话拨打911，而罗杰则去查看他的父亲。

sentences.en: First, he looked out a window by the front door to make sure the intruder's car was gone.
sentences.zh: 首先，他向正门旁的窗户张望，以确保闯入者的车已经开走了。

sentences.en: Then he locked the door and jammed a stick in another sliding glass door to prevent anyone from entering.
sentences.zh: 然后他锁上了门，并在另一扇推拉玻璃门上卡了一根棍子，以防任何人进来。

sentences.en: After this, he finally headed upstairs.
sentences.zh: 在此之后，他终于上楼去了。

sentences.en: Pamela was speaking to the 911 operator when Roger found his father's body in a small bathroom.
sentences.zh: 当罗杰在小浴室里发现他父亲的尸体时，帕梅拉正在和911接线员通话。

sentences.en: Kay was kneeling over the bathtub which had a sliding glass door.
sentences.zh: 凯跪在装有推拉玻璃门的浴缸上方。

sentences.en: As well as a deep slash to Kay's throat, he had been stabbed in the back of the neck.
sentences.zh: 除了凯的喉咙被深深割开外，他的后颈也被刺伤了。

sentences.en: The murder weapon, a sharp kitchen knife with a long blood-stained blade, was lying in the bathtub.
sentences.zh: 凶器是一把沾满血迹的锋利长刃厨房刀，正躺在浴缸里。

sentences.en: The knife had been taken from Kay's own kitchen.
sentences.zh: 这把刀是从凯自己的厨房里拿走的。

sentences.en: Roger went back downstairs to tell Pamela that Kay was dead and she passed this on to 911 before handing the phone to Roger.
sentences.zh: 罗杰回到楼下告诉帕梅拉凯已经死了，帕梅拉将此转告给911，然后把电话交给了罗杰。

sentences.en: Responding officers noted that there was surprisingly little damage for a home invasion.
sentences.zh: 出警警员指出，对于一起入室盗窃案来说，现场的破坏出奇地少。

sentences.en: Someone had gone to a great effort to keep the crime scene tidy, even killing Kay over the bathtub to avoid spilling blood on the floor.
sentences.zh: 有人费了很大力气来保持犯罪现场的整洁，甚至把凯杀死在浴缸上方，以避免血液溅到地板上。

sentences.en: Forensic investigators couldn't recover any useful DNA or fingerprints from the house.
sentences.zh: 法医调查人员无法从房子里提取出任何有用的DNA或指纹。

sentences.en: They believed this indicated the perpetrators either had lots of time to clean up or there hadn't been much of a struggle at all.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这表明行凶者要么有充足的时间清理现场，要么根本没有发生太多的挣扎。

sentences.en: Roger had told 911 that the intruders must have targeted his father because he was rich.
sentences.zh: 罗杰曾告诉911，闯入者一定是因为他有钱才把他的父亲作为目标。

sentences.en: This was backed up by something one of the men had supposedly told the couple, stating that they were robbing Kay to support their families.
sentences.zh: 这一点得到了其中一名男子据称对这对夫妇所说的话的支持，该男子声称他们抢劫凯是为了养家糊口。

sentences.en: But Kay's valuables had been left behind, mostly.
sentences.zh: 但凯的贵重物品大部分都留在了原地。

sentences.en: Kay Mortensen loved guns and spent a lot of money adding to his firearm collection.
sentences.zh: 凯·莫滕森喜爱枪支，并花了很多钱扩充他的枪械收藏。

sentences.en: In total, he owned about 100, some of which were extremely valuable.
sentences.zh: 总共他拥有大约100支，其中一些极其珍贵。

sentences.en: Kay's firearms were scattered throughout the house, but he kept about 20 in an outdoor underground concrete bunker that he'd built himself.
sentences.zh: 凯的枪械散落在屋子各处，但他把大约20支放在了他自己建造的一个室外地下混凝土掩体里。

sentences.en: Kay was a survivalist who believed in self-protection and had built the bunker in case of an emergency.
sentences.zh: 凯是一个生存主义者，相信自我保护，并为了应对紧急情况建造了这个掩体。

sentences.en: It was stocked with everything he and his wife Dala could ever need to survive – food, water, weapons, first aid supplies, and even reading materials.
sentences.zh: 里面备齐了他和妻子达拉生存所需的一切物资——食物、水、武器、急救用品，甚至还有阅读材料。

sentences.en: Only his closest friends and family knew about the bunker.
sentences.zh: 只有他最亲密的朋友和家人知道这个掩体。

sentences.en: Investigators soon discovered that the shelves in the bunker were empty.
sentences.zh: 调查人员很快发现，掩体里的架子是空的。

sentences.en: All of the firearms he had stored down there were missing.
sentences.zh: 他存放在那里的所有枪械都不见了。

sentences.en: It didn't take long for investigators to grow suspicious.
sentences.zh: 调查人员没花多久就开始起疑了。

sentences.en: Something about Roger and Pamela's story wasn't adding up for them.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和帕梅拉故事中的某些地方对他们来说说不通。

sentences.en: First of all, the crime scene didn't add up.
sentences.zh: 首先，犯罪现场说不通。

sentences.en: Roger and Pamela had said the men were strangers, but there was no sign of forced entry.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和帕梅拉说过这些人是陌生人，但没有强行闯入的迹象。

sentences.en: Drawers and safes throughout the house were left untouched.
sentences.zh: 房子各处的抽屉和保险箱都完好无损。

sentences.en: It didn't look like the place had been ransacked, as would be expected if random burglars were responsible.
sentences.zh: 这看起来并不像是一个地方被洗劫过，如果是一群随意的江洋大盗作案，本该是那样的。

sentences.en: Nor did it look like any of the victims had put up a struggle.
sentences.zh: 看起来也不像任何受害者进行了反抗。

sentences.en: It also seemed as though the men had somehow known about Kay's secret bunker.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来这些人不知为何对凯的秘密掩体了如指掌。

sentences.en: The only firearms stolen were the ones kept in there, even though Kay's most valuable, exclusive, and antique guns were in his bedroom, locked away in two separate safes.
sentences.zh: 被偷走的唯一枪支就是存放在那里的那些，尽管凯伊最有价值、最独特、也是年代久远的古董枪都放在他的卧室里，锁在两个独立的保险箱中。

sentences.en: The safes also held Kay's gold and silver coin collections.
sentences.zh: 保险箱里还存放着凯伊的金币和银币收藏品。

sentences.en: As a survivalist who was mistrustful of the government,
sentences.zh: 作为一名对政府充满不信任的生存主义者，

sentences.en: Kay had invested in these coins to ensure his wealth would remain during periods of potential disaster or economic downturn.
sentences.zh: 凯伊投资了这些硬币，以确保在潜在的灾害或经济低迷时期，他的财富能够得以保留。

sentences.en: When a locksmith managed to open the safes up for law enforcement, they saw that none of the coins or Kay's valuable guns had been stolen.
sentences.zh: 当开锁匠设法为执法部门打开保险箱时，他们发现无论是硬币还是凯伊的宝贵枪支，都没有被偷。

sentences.en: Investigators thought the entire situation looked more like someone staging a burglary without wanting to actually lose any items of value.
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为，整个情况看起来更像是某人在伪造入室盗窃的现场，却又不想真正损失任何有价值的物品。

sentences.en: Other aspects of the scene also seemed strange.
sentences.zh: 现场的其他方面也显得很奇怪。

sentences.en: Pamela had said she'd seen one of the men standing outside the living room window holding a broom.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉曾说，她看到其中一名男子拿着一把扫帚站在起居室窗户外面。

sentences.en: But a fresh area of snow showed no signs of footprints or someone having swept in the vicinity.
sentences.zh: 但一块新积雪的地面上却没有任何脚印或附近有人打扫过的迹象。

sentences.en: There was evidence of a snowy patch having been swept on the north side of the house.
sentences.zh: 有证据表明，房子北侧的一小片雪地被人打扫过。

sentences.en: However, Pamela wouldn't have been able to see this area if she'd been held hostage in the living room, as she claimed.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如她所声称的那样，如果她当时被当成人质关在起居室里，帕梅拉是不可能看到这一区域的。

sentences.en: Although Pamela had said she'd cut off the majority of the couple's zip ties, the discarded ties were intact and hadn't been cut.
sentences.zh: 尽管帕梅拉曾说她割断了这对夫妇大部分的扎带，但丢弃的扎带却完好无损，根本没有被割断。

sentences.en: Pamela claimed to have stretched the ones on her wrists to remove them.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉声称她是把手腕上的扎带撑大后才脱下来的。

sentences.en: But when investigators experimented with the ties, they found the plastic was too hard to stretch.
sentences.zh: 但当调查人员对扎带进行实验时，他们发现这种塑料太硬，根本无法撑大。

sentences.en: Nor were there any marks on the couple's wrists which would have been left by tight zip ties.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的手腕上也没有任何紧绷的扎带通常会留下的痕迹。

sentences.en: Investigators suspected Pamela and Roger had secured the restraints loosely to make it look as though they were taken hostage without actually being tied up.
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑，帕梅拉和罗杰只是松垮地绑了绑约束物，以此伪装成被劫持为人质的样子，而实际上根本没有被绑起来。

sentences.en: The fact that Kay Mortensen had been murdered with a knife seemed vicious and personal, not what you'd expect to see if he'd been killed by two strangers
sentences.zh: 凯伊·莫滕森是被一把刀残忍杀害的，这看起来极其恶劣且带有私人恩怨，绝不像被两个带着手枪的陌生人杀死的情形

sentences.en: who were carrying a handgun.
sentences.zh: 这两个陌生人还随身携带了手枪。

sentences.en: As well as being a survivalist who was armed and on high alert to defend himself,
sentences.zh: 除了是一个全副武装、高度警惕以保护自己的生存主义者之外，

sentences.en: Kay had a black belt in karate.
sentences.zh: 凯伊还拥有空手道黑带。

sentences.en: He should have been able to fight back against intruders who turned up at his home.
sentences.zh: 对于那些出现在他家里的不速之客，他本该有能力进行反击。

sentences.en: It seemed far more likely that he'd been targeted by people he knew and trusted when his guard was down.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，他更可能是在放松警惕时，成为了他所认识并信任的人的目标。

sentences.en: Finally, investigators were struck by what they perceived as Roger and Pamela's strange demeanours.
sentences.zh: 最后，罗杰和帕梅拉表现出的怪异举止给调查人员留下了深刻印象。

sentences.en: Both appeared calm and not in the least bit grief-stricken despite the grisly scene at Kay's home or their own supposed ordeal.
sentences.zh: 尽管凯伊家中发生了骇人听闻的场景，且他们自己也经历了一场所谓的磨难，但两人看起来都很平静，没有一丝悲痛的样子。

sentences.en: The details of their stories seemed to change and there were elements that were just plain odd,
sentences.zh: 他们话里的细节似乎一直在变，其中有些元素简直匪夷所思，

sentences.en: like Roger saying he'd asked the intruders if they could take their pecan pie and leave.
sentences.zh: 比如罗杰说他曾问过那些不速之客，能不能拿走他们的山核桃派再离开。

sentences.en: Why would he be thinking about the pecan pie in such a stressful situation?
sentences.zh: 在如此紧张的情况下，他怎么会去想山核桃派？

sentences.en: The sheriff's deputies realised they needed to separate Roger and Pamela Mortensen, then interview them individually.
sentences.zh: 警长副手们意识到，他们需要将罗杰和帕梅拉·莫滕森分开，然后分别对他们进行讯问。

sentences.en: They placed the couple in two different deputies' cars in order to drive them down to the station.
sentences.zh: 他们将两人分别安排在两辆不同的警车里，准备把他们带回警局。

sentences.en: One deputy noticed Roger making eye contact with Pamela through their car windows.
sentences.zh: 一名副手注意到罗杰透过车窗与帕梅拉有眼神交流。

sentences.en: He was grinning at his wife and gave her a thumbs up.
sentences.zh: 他朝着妻子咧嘴笑，还对她竖起了大拇指。

sentences.en: When he realised the deputy was watching him, his smile immediately vanished and he put his hands in his lap.
sentences.zh: 当他意识到副手在看着他时，笑容瞬间消失了，并把双手放在了大腿上。

sentences.en: Pamela still seemed calm and was chatty with the deputies who escorted her to the station.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉依然显得很平静，并与护送她去警局的副手们有说有笑。

sentences.en: She talked about her work and several television programs she was missing due to the evening's events.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了自己的工作，以及因为今晚发生的事情而错过的几个电视节目。

sentences.en: During her interrogation, detectives noted a complete absence of emotion when she discussed her deceased father-in-law.
sentences.zh: 在审讯过程中，侦探们注意到，当她谈到已故的岳父时，完全流露不出任何情绪。

sentences.en: They showed Pamela a photo line-up of possible suspects, but she didn't recognise any.
sentences.zh: 他们向帕梅拉出示了一组可能的嫌疑人照片，但她一个也不认识。

sentences.en: One detective cut to the chase, stating,
sentences.zh: 一名侦探开门见山地说道：

sentences.en: This story is a bunch of crap that you and Roger have come up with, okay?
sentences.zh: 这个故事纯粹是你和罗杰编造的一堆废话，对吧？

sentences.en: Is your husband capable of killing somebody?
sentences.zh: 你丈夫有能力杀人吗？

sentences.en: Pamela stammered slightly in her reply, saying,
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉在回答时微微结巴，说道：

sentences.en: I wouldn't hope.
sentences.zh: 我希望没有吧。

sentences.en: I mean, I wouldn't think he is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得他不会。

sentences.en: I wouldn't think that he is capable of killing his father.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他没有能力杀害自己的父亲。

sentences.en: I know we are in a lot of debt, but we, I personally, would not have my father-in-law killed for his money.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们负债累累，但我，或者说我个人，绝不会为了钱而让人谋杀我的岳父。

sentences.en: While Roger was being driven to the sheriff's department, he seemed relaxed and eager to chat.
sentences.zh: 在被押往警长部门的途中，罗杰显得很放松，且渴望聊天。

sentences.en: He asked lots of questions about the equipment in the deputy's car and was keen to know how it all worked.
sentences.zh: 他问了许多关于副手车上设备的问题，并且很想知道这一切是如何运作的。

sentences.en: While waiting to be taken into an interview room, he continued to talk, telling deputies about his job and other random topics.
sentences.zh: 在等待被带进讯问室时，他一直在说话，向副手们讲述他的工作和其他随机的话题。

sentences.en: A couple of times he referred to his father's death, but he didn't seem upset and never cried.
sentences.zh: 他有好几次提到他父亲的死，但他看起来并不难过，也从未哭过。

sentences.en: At one point, he described his father as, quote, a cantankerous old fart.
sentences.zh: 有一回，他用“引述”来形容他的父亲是一个“难缠的老混蛋”。

sentences.en: Sometimes he stood up to stretch, explaining that he had an uncomfortable back injury.
sentences.zh: 他有时会站起来伸展身体，解释说他有背部伤痛，坐着很不舒服。

sentences.en: Roger was quick to suggest possible suspects, including a former student of his father's named Mike, who owed Kay money.
sentences.zh: 罗杰很快便提出了几个可能的嫌疑人，其中包括他父亲以前的一个学生迈克，此人欠了凯伊的钱。

sentences.en: Kay had taken some of Mike's guns as collateral and was storing them in the bunker.
sentences.zh: 凯伊曾拿走迈克的一些枪支作为抵押品，并将它们存放在掩体里。

sentences.en: Now, they were all gone.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些枪全都不见了。

sentences.en: Detectives quickly tracked Mike down and established that he had an airtight alibi for the evening.
sentences.zh: 侦探们很快找到了迈克，并证实他在当晚有不在场的人证铁证。

sentences.en: Mike also explained that Kay had bought the guns from him because he needed money.
sentences.zh: 迈克还解释说，因为当时急需用钱，凯伊才从他手里买下了那些枪。

sentences.en: Some of the details in Roger's story changed during his interview.
sentences.zh: 在讯问过程中，罗杰说辞中的一些细节发生了变化。

sentences.en: He said the suspects had been wearing fuzzy, blue women's gloves.
sentences.zh: 他说嫌疑人戴着毛茸茸的蓝色女式手套。

sentences.en: Then he later said they hadn't been wearing gloves at all.
sentences.zh: 但后来他又说他们根本没戴手套。

sentences.en: But for the most part, his version of events stayed the same.
sentences.zh: 不过在大多数情况下，他叙述的事情经过还是保持了一致。

sentences.en: Roger again told the story of how the men had changed their minds about killing them after hearing him pray.
sentences.zh: 罗杰再次讲述了那些人在听到他祈祷后，如何改变了杀害他们主意的事情。

sentences.en: This struck investigators as particularly implausible.
sentences.zh: 调查人员觉得这尤其令人难以置信。

sentences.en: It seemed absurd that the men would viciously kill Kay Mortensen in cold blood, then allow two witnesses to live.
sentences.zh: 那些人冷血残忍地杀害了凯伊·莫滕森，却又放过两名目击者，这看起来荒谬至极。

sentences.en: They told Roger Mortensen as such and said they didn't believe what he and Pamela were saying.
sentences.zh: 他们对罗杰·莫滕森直言不讳，并表示他们不相信他和帕梅拉所说的话。

sentences.en: Roger replied,
sentences.zh: 罗杰回答说：

sentences.en: I'm sorry you don't believe me, but...
sentences.zh: 很遗憾你们不相信我，不过……

sentences.en: Then he trailed off.
sentences.zh: 接着他的声音渐渐变小，没有说下去。

sentences.en: He shrugged and rested his head in one hand before looking at one of the detectives and asking,
sentences.zh: 他耸了耸肩，用一只手托着头，然后看着其中一名侦探问道：

sentences.en: does it sound too rehearsed or...
sentences.zh: 这听起来是不是太像排练过了，还是说……

sentences.en: The detective told him it did.
sentences.zh: 侦探告诉他确实如此。

sentences.en: Okay, was all Roger said in reply.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是罗杰回答的全部内容。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案卷》节目稍后将继续播出。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目赞助商的广告，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持《案卷》继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: Looking into Kay Mortensen's life, investigators quickly realised he'd been a complex individual.
sentences.zh: 在深入调查凯伊·莫滕森的生活后，调查人员很快意识到他是一个复杂的人物。

sentences.en: Kay had enjoyed a long career as a professor at Brigham Young University, an LDS tertiary institution.
sentences.zh: 凯伊曾在杨百翰大学——一所耶稣基督后期圣徒教会的高等学府——度过了漫长的教学生涯。

sentences.en: He taught the subjects of engineering technology, manufacturing technology, and manufacturing design, and was popular with his students.
sentences.zh: 他教授工程技术、制造技术和制造设计等课程，深受学生们的喜爱。

sentences.en: They liked the way he told stories to capture their interest instead of just lecturing at them.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢他用讲故事的方式来吸引他们的注意力，而不是仅仅向他们灌输知识。

sentences.en: In addition to his successful career,
sentences.zh: 除了成功的职业生涯之外，

sentences.en: Kay had made a number of financial investments over the years that had made him a multi-millionaire.
sentences.zh: 多年来，凯伊还进行了一系列金融投资，这使他成为了一个千万富翁。

sentences.en: He was known to be generous with his wealth, sharing it with those he loved.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，他在财富上非常慷慨，愿意与所爱的人分享。

sentences.en: A few people owed him money from substantial loans he'd given them, but those who knew Kay said he hadn't been worried or pressured anyone to repay him.
sentences.zh: 由于他曾借出过大笔贷款，有几个人还欠着他的钱，但认识凯伊的人说，他并不着急，也没有向任何人施压要求还款。

sentences.en: At the same time,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Kay could rub some people the wrong way.
sentences.zh: 凯伊也有可能惹人生厌。

sentences.en: He was described as opinionated, dogmatic, stubborn, and quick-tempered.
sentences.zh: 据描述，他独断专行、教条主义、顽固不化且脾气暴躁。

sentences.en: Sometimes he got into arguments about politics or religion, and there was a number of failed relationships in his paSt.
sentences.zh: 有时他会因为政治或宗教问题与人争吵，他的过去也有过好几段失败的感情经历。

sentences.en: Kay had been married and divorced twice before meeting Dala.
sentences.zh: 在遇到达拉之前，凯伊曾结过两次婚，也都以离婚告终。

sentences.en: He'd had a falling out with his sister regarding guardianship for their mother and disabled brother, and Kay had disowned one of his sons who held a long-standing grudge
sentences.zh: 他曾因母亲和残疾弟弟的监护权问题与姐姐闹翻，并且凯伊还与他的一个儿子断绝了父子关系，后者长期对他怀恨在心

sentences.en: due to Kay not paying his child support or funding his college education.
sentences.zh: 原因则是凯伊没有支付抚养费或资助他的大学教育。

sentences.en: Detectives also learnt about a disagreement
sentences.zh: 侦探们还了解到了一起纠纷，

sentences.en: Kay had with a former business partner and a particularly troubling dispute with a neighbour.
sentences.zh: 那是凯伊与前商业伙伴之间的一场争执，以及与邻居之间一起特别令人头疼的争端。

sentences.en: Three and a half years earlier, in May 2006,
sentences.zh: 三年半前，即2006年5月，

sentences.en: Kay's neighbour Cindy let her pet Great Dane out of its kennel just as Kay was driving past the property.
sentences.zh: 凯伊的邻居辛迪正把她养的宠物大丹犬放出来透风，恰好这时凯伊开车从房产旁驶过。

sentences.en: According to Cindy, the dog had started barking at Kay.
sentences.zh: 据辛迪所说，那只狗开始对凯伊狂吠。

sentences.en: In response,
sentences.zh: 作为回应，

sentences.en: Kay had stopped his car and shot the dog dead.
sentences.zh: 凯伊停下车，开枪把狗打死了。

sentences.en: Kay claimed that the Great Dane had attacked him and he only shot it in self-defence.
sentences.zh: 凯伊声称那只大丹犬袭击了他，他开枪纯属自卫。

sentences.en: He was subsequently charged with animal cruelty and discharging a firearm from a vehicle.
sentences.zh: 随后，他被控虐待动物和从车内发射枪支。

sentences.en: He pleaded not guilty to both charges, and eventually beat the case.
sentences.zh: 他对这两项指控均坚决不认罪，最终打赢了这场官司。

sentences.en: Despite these disputes throughout Kay's past, investigators quickly concluded that they'd had nothing to do with his murder.
sentences.zh: 尽管凯伊的过去存在这些纠纷，但调查人员很快得出结论，这些与他的谋杀案毫无关系。

sentences.en: In addition to questioning his son Roger and daughter-in-law Pamela, detectives made interviewing
sentences.zh: 除了盘问他的儿子罗杰和儿媳帕梅拉之外，侦探们将讯问

sentences.en: Kay's wife, Dala, a top priority.
sentences.zh: 凯伊的妻子达拉列为重中之重。

sentences.en: On the evening of Monday November 16,
sentences.zh: 11月16日星期一的傍晚，

sentences.en: Dala Mortensen was driving home to the Payson Canyon property when she received a call from a neighbour.
sentences.zh: 达拉·莫滕森正开车返回佩森峡谷的住所，突然接到了一个邻居的电话。

sentences.en: He'd noticed a commotion at the Mortensen residence with the sheriff's deputies descending on the property.
sentences.zh: 邻居注意到莫滕森的住所发生了一场骚乱，警长副手们正蜂拥赶往该处地产。

sentences.en: Dala's first thought was that her husband Kay must have shot a would-be burglar.
sentences.zh: 达拉的第一反应是，她的丈夫凯伊肯定枪击了一个企图入室的窃贼。

sentences.en: He had always told her that if anyone tried to break into his property, he would kill them.
sentences.zh: 他总是对她说，如果有人敢擅闯他的宅邸，他就会杀了对方。

sentences.en: Dala knew just how prepared he was for any kind of attack.
sentences.zh: 达拉深知他为了应对任何形式的袭击做好了多么充分的准备。

sentences.en: Scared and panicked, she called a friend and asked them to meet her at the property.
sentences.zh: 她感到害怕和惊慌，于是打电话给一位朋友，请对方去住所和她会合。

sentences.en: When Dala and her friend arrived at Payson Canyon, they found that law enforcement had blocked off the street.
sentences.zh: 当达拉和朋友抵达佩森峡谷时，发现执法人员已经封锁了街道。

sentences.en: Dala made her way to the nearest officer and explained the situation.
sentences.zh: 达拉走到最近的警员面前，向对方说明了情况。

sentences.en: She was taken to a command post that had been set up at the bottom of the hill that led to her home.
sentences.zh: 她被带到一个指挥所，该指挥所设在通往她家住所的山脚下。

sentences.en: Dala was informed that her husband hadn't killed an intruder as she'd expected.
sentences.zh: 达拉被告知，她的丈夫并没有像她预料的那样杀死入侵者。

sentences.en: Instead, he was the victim of an attack.
sentences.zh: 相反，他成为了袭击的受害者。

sentences.en: Dala looked grief-stricken.
sentences.zh: 达拉看上去悲痛欲绝。

sentences.en: Detectives noted that her open distress was markedly different to how Kay's son Roger had appeared.
sentences.zh: 侦探们注意到，她毫不掩饰的痛苦与凯伊的儿子罗杰之前的表现形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: According to those who knew Kay and Dala, their love had been deep and Dala had a calming effect on her husband.
sentences.zh: 据那些了解凯伊和达拉的人说，他们情深意笃，而且达拉对她的丈夫有一种安抚作用。

sentences.en: Prior to getting married, she had agreed to sign a prenuptial agreement so Kay could protect his financial assets.
sentences.zh: 在结婚之前，她曾同意签署一份婚前协议，以便凯伊能够保护自己的金融资产。

sentences.en: Dala told detectives that Kay had always been paranoid when it came to his personal safety.
sentences.zh: 达拉告诉侦探，在个人安全方面，凯伊一直有些被害妄想。

sentences.en: He carried a gun with him at all times and would insist they enter their homes via the garage instead of the front door.
sentences.zh: 他随身携带枪支，并坚持让他们从车库进入家门，而不是走前门。

sentences.en: The fact that he could have been caught off guard by intruders struck her as very unlikely.
sentences.zh: 她觉得他居然会被入侵者打个措手不及，这简直是不可能的事。

sentences.en: After listening to audio of Roger and Pamela
sentences.zh: 在听取了罗杰和帕梅拉·

sentences.en: Mortensen's police interviews,

sentences.zh: 调查人员随后与莫滕森家族的其他成员进行了交谈。

sentences.en: Some mentioned that during Roger's childhood he might have experienced physical and emotional abuse at Kay's hands.
sentences.zh: 一些人提到，在罗杰的童年时期，他可能经受过凯伊施加的身体和情感虐待。

sentences.en: It turned out that Roger also had a criminal record.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，罗杰还有犯罪前科。

sentences.en: During his adult years, he had struggled with substance abuse, becoming addicted to cannabis and cocaine.
sentences.zh: 在其成年期间，他曾与药物滥用作斗争，对大麻和可卡因产生了瘾。

sentences.en: It also sounded like he had a temper.
sentences.zh: 听起来他的脾气也不小。

sentences.en: Thirteen years earlier, in 1996, a driver was taking some Boy Scouts on an excursion through American Fork Canyon when Roger Mortensen passed by them in an all-terrain vehicle.
sentences.zh: 十三年前的1996年，一名司机正带着一些童子军在美利坚福克峡谷进行远足，当时罗杰·莫滕森驾驶着一辆全地形车从他们身旁驶过。

sentences.en: For some reason, he became very agitated, stopped his ATV, and pulled out a handgun.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，他变得十分情绪激动，停下全地形车，拔出了一把手枪。

sentences.en: He began waving it at the other driver, who quickly continued on to escape him.
sentences.zh: 他开始挥舞手枪指向另一名司机，后者迅速加速逃离了他。

sentences.en: They reported the incident to authorities, who tracked Roger down and found both the gun and a cannabis pipe in his possession.
sentences.zh: 他们向当局报告了这一事件，当局随后追踪到罗杰，并在他身上搜出了枪支和一个吸大麻的烟斗。

sentences.en: He also had a radar unit that had been stolen from Utah Highway Patrol, valued at $4,000.
sentences.zh: 他还藏有一个从犹他州公路巡警那里偷来的雷达装置，价值4000美元。

sentences.en: Roger was charged with aggravated assault, drug possession, and receiving stolen property.
sentences.zh: 罗杰被指控犯有严重攻击罪、藏毒罪以及收受赃物罪。

sentences.en: He pleaded no contest and his charges were reduced, resulting in him receiving probation.
sentences.zh: 他对指控未作抗辩，指控随后被减轻，最终他受到了缓刑处分。

sentences.en: The following year,
sentences.zh: 第二年，

sentences.en: Roger helped a friend steal dozens of tools from a hardware store.
sentences.zh: 罗杰帮一个朋友从五金店偷走了几十件工具。

sentences.en: Roger had also been married three times prior to meeting Pamela.
sentences.zh: 在遇到帕梅拉之前，罗杰也结过三次婚。

sentences.en: Roger and his then-wife sought protective orders against each other.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和他当时的妻子互相申请了人身保护令。

sentences.en: According to Roger's wife, he had started claiming he could see the devil.
sentences.zh: 据罗杰的妻子称，他当时开始声称自己能看到魔鬼。

sentences.en: She also said that he abused cannabis and alcohol frequently and was physically violent, throwing her against a wall and slapping her.
sentences.zh: 她还说他频繁滥用大麻和酒精，并且有暴力倾向，曾把她推向墙上并掌掴她。

sentences.en: Roger said in his own protective order application that she was lying about these assaults.
sentences.zh: 罗杰在自己的人身保护令申请中称，她是在关于这些袭击事件撒谎。

sentences.en: The orders were granted, but Roger was later convicted of violating it when he made harassing phone calls to his wife.
sentences.zh: 保护令得到了批准，但罗杰后来因对妻子进行骚扰电话滋扰而违反了保护令，并因此被定罪。

sentences.en: A judge ordered Roger to attend anger management classes and the couple ultimately divorced.
sentences.zh: 法官下令罗杰参加愤怒管理课程，这对夫妇最终以离婚收场。

sentences.en: Roger's father,
sentences.zh: 罗杰的父亲

sentences.en: Kay, had been there during his son's struggles.
sentences.zh: 凯伊，一直在儿子陷入困境时陪伴左右。

sentences.en: He would bail him out when he needed it and helped Roger stop using drugs.
sentences.zh: 当他需要时，他会为他保释，并帮助罗杰戒毒。

sentences.en: The pair bonded over their love of firearms and would trade guns together.
sentences.zh: 父子俩因对枪支的喜爱而紧密相连，还经常一起买卖枪支。

sentences.en: Roger said that he and his dad had been best friends.
sentences.zh: 罗杰说，他和父亲是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: Quote, As best friends as you can be with a grumpy old man.
sentences.zh: 原话是：“和一个脾气暴躁的老头能有多好，大概就有多好吧。”

sentences.en: Shortly after Kay's murder, detectives learned that Roger had gone to a bank where Kay had kept a security box that contained more than $800,000 worth of gold and silver.
sentences.zh: 凯伊遇害后不久，侦探们得知罗杰曾去过一家银行，凯伊在那里租有一个保险箱，里面藏有价值超过八十万美元的金银制品。

sentences.en: Roger had tried to access the security box but wasn't allowed.
sentences.zh: 罗杰曾试图打开这个保险箱，但遭到拒绝。

sentences.en: The case investigators couldn't understand why Roger would do such a thing so soon after his father's murder, especially as he had siblings who were also entitled to Kay's estate.
sentences.zh: 案子调查人员无法理解，为什么罗杰在父亲遇害后不久会做出这种事，尤其是在他还有其他同样有权继承凯伊遗产的兄弟姐妹的情况下。

sentences.en: Roger's interest in his father's wealth looked like a clear motive to the police.
sentences.zh: 警方认为，罗杰对父亲财富的兴趣构成了明显的动机。

sentences.en: Kay had put most of his money into a trust for his children to receive one day and Roger was set to inherit a fortune in the event of his father's death.
sentences.zh: 凯伊把大部分钱都放进了一个信托基金里，留给他的孩子们将来继承，而罗杰注定会在父亲去世后继承一笔巨额财富。

sentences.en: They froze and seized
sentences.zh: 他们冻结并查封了

sentences.en: Kay's assets.
sentences.zh: 凯伊的资产。

sentences.en: Investigators searched
sentences.zh: 调查人员搜查了

sentences.en: Roger and Pamela's home.
sentences.zh: 罗杰和帕梅拉的住所。

sentences.en: Scattered throughout the house, detectives noticed a number of letters that turned out to be collection notices and unsent mortgage repayment forMs.
sentences.zh: 在屋子各处，侦探们注意到许多信件，结果证明那是催收通知和未寄出的房贷还款表格。

sentences.en: It seemed the couple owed thousands of dollars and were in financial trouble.
sentences.zh: 看来这对夫妇欠下了数千美元债务，陷入了财务困境。

sentences.en: This was consistent with Pamela's remark about being in debt during her police interview.
sentences.zh: 这与帕梅拉在警方讯问时提到自己身负债务的情况吻合。

sentences.en: Detectives noticed some sawdust on the floor beneath a heating furnace with a wood panel.
sentences.zh: 侦探们注意到，一个带有木镶板的暖气炉下方地板上有一些木屑。

sentences.en: Looked as though someone had recently been meddling with the panel.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是最近有人动过那个镶板。

sentences.en: They removed it and found a 12-gauge shotgun and an AK-47 stashed behind the furnace along with several thousand rounds of ammunition.
sentences.zh: 他们拆下镶板，发现炉子后面藏着一把12号散弹枪和一把AK-47，以及数千发子弹。

sentences.en: Roger Mortensen wasn't permitted to own guns due to his previous convictions.
sentences.zh: 由于有前科，罗杰·莫滕森本不被允许拥有枪支。

sentences.en: Believing these could be the firearms that had been stolen from Kay Mortensen's bunker, the detectives took them in for examination.
sentences.zh: 侦探们认为这些可能就是从凯伊·莫滕森地堡中被盗的枪支，于是将它们带回做进一步检验。

sentences.en: In the garage, detectives found a safe with a .22-caliber revolver inside.
sentences.zh: 在车库里，侦探们发现了一个保险箱，里面有一把.22口径左轮手枪。

sentences.en: There were also two round plastic containers in the garage that were filled with cannabis.
sentences.zh: 车库里还有两个装满大麻的圆形塑料容器。

sentences.en: Possessing cannabis for any purpose was illegal in Utah at the time and Roger's criminal record meant he was committing a felony.
sentences.zh: 当时在犹他州，以任何目的持有大麻都是非法的，而罗杰的犯罪记录意味着他是在犯重罪。

sentences.en: Roger Mortensen's green jeep was also taken for processing.
sentences.zh: 罗杰·莫滕森的绿色吉普车也被带走进行取证检查。

sentences.zh: 侦探们带着

sentences.zh: 罗杰回到他父亲的房子，并让他还原袭击发生的整个过程。

sentences.zh: 他们注意到，在现场还原过程中，

sentences.zh: 凯伊的儿子居然想靠近父亲遇害的地方，这实在说不通。

sentences.en: Roger repeatedly referred to the two perpetrators as gentlemen, which also seemed strange.
sentences.zh: 罗杰反复把两名行凶者称为“绅士”，这也显得很怪异。

sentences.zh: 当对罗杰进行测试时，他变得异常激动，突然转向操作员说道：“我知道我父亲是怎么被谋杀的。”

sentences.zh: 接着他双膝跪地，摆出父亲遇害前身处的那种姿势，然后做出了拿刀划过喉咙的动作。

sentences.zh: 罗杰的测试结果显示他未通过测谎。
